svg.title: Kleidos bench meter rig schematic
svg.desc: Wiring of the Kleidos bench meter: an INA228 across a 0.1 Ω shunt between a board's cell and the board, with the relays that open the lead and bypass the shunt.

cc:Work.dc:description: Wiring of the Kleidos bench meter: an INA228 across a 0.1 Ω shunt between a board's cell and the board, with the relays that open the lead and bypass the shunt.

g.text: Meter ESP32-S3 N16R8 on the DAQ carrier

g.desc: Meter ESP32-S3 N16R8 on the DAQ carrier

g.style: fill:#111111; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#111111; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: R100's value is the calibration registry's (calibration/), never this drawing's. Sheet 2 draws its calibration.

g.desc: R100's value is the calibration registry's (calibration/), never this drawing's. Sheet 2 draws its calibration.

g.text: HW-316 relays: K1 opens the DUT lead, K2 bypasses the shunt.

g.desc: HW-316 relays: K1 opens the DUT lead, K2 bypasses the shunt.

g.text: Drawn to the Kleidos KiCad style; the wiring is rev C's.

g.desc: Drawn to the Kleidos KiCad style; the wiring is rev C's.

g.text: U3's and U4's GND go to G (T22) on the bench, with wires of their own.

g.desc: U3's and U4's GND go to G (T22) on the bench, with wires of their own.

g.text: Sheet 2: R100 calibrated against the 100 Ω reference, four-wire

g.desc: Sheet 2: R100 calibrated against the 100 Ω reference, four-wire

g.text: The bypass is the Relay 2 Click's RL1; of the HW-316 only IN1 and K1 are wired; pigtail 2 on VBUS; sheet 2.

g.desc: The bypass is the Relay 2 Click's RL1; of the HW-316 only IN1 and K1 are wired; pigtail 2 on VBUS; sheet 2.

g.text: INA228 breakout: what is on the board

g.desc: INA228 breakout: what is on the board

g.text: RL1's terminals hold the cell's +: keep them and every contact screw clear of G; K1 NO is live whenever K1 is on.

g.desc: RL1's terminals hold the cell's +: keep them and every contact screw clear of G; K1 NO is live whenever K1 is on.

g.text: Current path, the Kelvin sense, the lead and the bypass

g.desc: Current path, the Kelvin sense, the lead and the bypass

g.text: The INA228 rig as soldered and wired, normative: rev D's wiring, every relay released is rev B

g.desc: The INA228 rig as soldered and wired, normative: rev D's wiring, every relay released is rev B

g.text: HW-316 (U3): only K1 is used, the lead. SRD-05VDC-SL-C, Form C. Low-level trigger, VCC 5 V, JD-VCC fitted (JP1).

g.desc: HW-316 (U3): only K1 is used, the lead. SRD-05VDC-SL-C, Form C. Low-level trigger, VCC 5 V, JD-VCC fitted (JP1).

g.text: K1 stays mechanical: NC is closed at rest, so the DUT is fed with the meter off, and no on-resistance sits in series.

g.desc: K1 stays mechanical: NC is closed at rest, so the DUT is fed with the meter off, and no on-resistance sits in series.

g.text: IN low (~2 mA) = coil on; IN high (3.3 V) or floating = off. Only IN1 is wired: IN2-IN4 float, so K2-K4 never energize.

g.desc: IN low (~2 mA) = coil on; IN high (3.3 V) or floating = off. Only IN1 is wired: IN2-IN4 float, so K2-K4 never energize.

g.text: GPIO16 (T9) and GPIO17 (T10) reach nothing: the firmware still drives them as the spares k3 and k4, with nothing attached.

g.desc: GPIO16 (T9) and GPIO17 (T10) reach nothing: the firmware still drives them as the spares k3 and k4, with nothing attached.

g.text: U4, Relay 2 Click: two LCA717, normally open, 0.15 Ω max, 3 ms max each way at 5 mA. RL1 drawn: control on PWM (16), active high.

g.desc: U4, Relay 2 Click: two LCA717, normally open, 0.15 Ω max, 3 ms max each way at 5 mA. RL1 drawn: control on PWM (16), active high.

g.text: On the bench RL2 is fitted: control on mikroBUS AN (1), the RELAY2 terminals. The same circuit (MikroE: RL1 = PWM, RL2 = AN).

g.desc: On the bench RL2 is fitted: control on mikroBUS AN (1), the RELAY2 terminals. The same circuit (MikroE: RL1 = PWM, RL2 = AN).

g.text: Image meter_relay2: GPIO15 low at boot and reset, high closes the bypass. The plain meter image drives it high: never with U4.

g.desc: Image meter_relay2: GPIO15 low at boot and reset, high closes the bypass. The plain meter image drives it high: never with U4.

g.text: Released (meter off, booting, reset): K1 NC closed, the DUT fed through the shunt; RL1 open (no LED current), no bypass.

g.desc: Released (meter off, booting, reset): K1 NC closed, the DUT fed through the shunt; RL1 open (no LED current), no bypass.

g.text: ROUT:NULL ON: RL1 closes, settles, then K1 opens: the shunt carries nothing and the DUT stays fed through RL1.

g.desc: ROUT:NULL ON: RL1 closes, settles, then K1 opens: the shunt carries nothing and the DUT stays fed through RL1.

g.text: Meter carrier and HW-316 relay module: only IN1 and K1, the lead, are wired

g.desc: Meter carrier and HW-316 relay module: only IN1 and K1, the lead, are wired

g.text: ROUT:NULL OFF: K1 recloses, settles, then RL1 opens. RL1 closed across a closed K1 bypasses most of the shunt.

g.desc: ROUT:NULL OFF: K1 recloses, settles, then RL1 opens. RL1 closed across a closed K1 bypasses most of the shunt.

g.text: Pigtail 2 lands on the VBUS screw and JP2 carries it to VIN+: VBUS reads the cell's side (CAL:VBUS SOUR).

g.desc: Pigtail 2 lands on the VBUS screw and JP2 carries it to VIN+: VBUS reads the cell's side (CAL:VBUS SOUR).

g.text: Negatives are not switched. K1 and RL1 sit outside the Kelvin sense: their contacts add burden, not error.

g.desc: Negatives are not switched. K1 and RL1 sit outside the Kelvin sense: their contacts add burden, not error.

g.text: VCC only from T21, the carrier's own 5 V: never a supply that can be up while the meter's 3.3 V is down.

g.desc: VCC only from T21, the carrier's own 5 V: never a supply that can be up while the meter's 3.3 V is down.

g.text: Meter ESP32-S3 N16R8 on the DAQ carrier

g.desc: Meter ESP32-S3 N16R8 on the DAQ carrier
